episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Tenacious insurance fraud investigator Cha Woo-seok gets a tip on an insurance murder, but the caller dies. Death seems to follow Han Seol-ah.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Woo-seok and detectives dig into Seol-ah's past to expose insurance murders, finding an odd pattern among her lovers. Amid doubt, his tenacity grows.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Chair Kim offers conditional succession. Seol-ah gets entangled with Jun-beom, Woo-seok nears her, and wine arrives in a dead man's name.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Hearing a recording of Seol-ah, Woo-seok feels pity and grows curious. The police arrest Seol-ah at the auction, and she resolves to end everything.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Woo-seok suggests posing as lovers, and Seol-ah agrees. Jun-beom consigns a painting to her, tension grows, and Woo-seok faces a shocking truth.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Seol-ah receives a threat and faces danger. Saved by Woo-seok, the two trace links between Paek Jun-beom and Lee Su-ho as Woo-seok is pursued.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Seol-ah traces the artwork fire incident to Chair Kim, learns of Woo-seok's wound, and confronts Jun-beom as Woo-seok probes Jun-beom and Su-ho.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Woo-seok spots links between the artwork fire incident and his sister's accident. Seol-ah follows Jun-beom to his villa, and the truth is revealed.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: An unexpected death shakes everyone. Afraid of losing Woo-seok, Seol-ah pushes him away. Back at the auction, she hastens plans against Chair Kim.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: Woo-seok and Seol-ah find a lead, but a painting raises her suspicion again. She prepares a final strike and enters the secret vault with Woo-seok.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: Seol-ah steps onto the final auction. She and Woo-seok seem to succeed in revenge, but its pain lingers. Another death warns the tragedy isn't over.

episodes.title: Final Episode
episodes.summary: Woo-seok and Seol-ah fight to save each other. They embrace their wounds, trying to reclaim daily life, perhaps with something left to protect.
